services.heading: Services
services.subheading: Four kinds of project, each for a different need.

labels.more: See what it includes and how it works

offerings.title: Landing page
offerings.need: I want to promote a service or a launch, or receive quote requests.
offerings.what: A single page focused on one offer or one specific goal. All of its content guides visitors to understand the proposal and get in touch.
when: Promoting a launch, event or campaign
Receiving quote requests in an organized way
Getting started online with little content
includes: A clear presentation of the offer
Sections for benefits, details and frequently asked questions
A layout adapted to desktop, tablet and phone
Basic setup for search engines and link sharing
offerings.practice: You share the information about your offer and we organize the content together into a sequence: introduction, benefits, details and contact. Then I build the page and fine-tune how it reads on every screen size.
offerings.nextStep: Tell me which offer you want to present, and to whom.

offerings.title: Business website
offerings.need: I want to present my company, with pages for services, information and contact.
offerings.what: A website with pages or areas that present the company, its services, useful information and ways to get in touch. It is the company's presence on the internet, organized so that each visitor finds what they are looking for.
when: The company offers more than one service or serves different audiences
Clients keep asking for the same information, such as address, opening hours and how you work
You want an official address to share on social media, business cards and in conversations
The content is expected to grow over time
includes: Pages such as Home, About, Services and Contact
A navigation menu adapted to phones
Map, opening hours and contact channels
Basic setup for search engines and link sharing
offerings.practice: First we decide which pages the website needs and how they connect. That map shapes the menu and the order of the content. Then I build the pages, keeping the same visual style across all of them.
offerings.nextStep: Tell me what your company does and what information your clients look for most.

offerings.title: Web app
offerings.need: I need a tool to record, track and look up information.
offerings.what: A tool used in the browser to carry out tasks and organize business information. Instead of scattered spreadsheets and messages, the data sits in one place, available to the people who need it.
when: The team keeps track of information across several spreadsheets or notes
Requests arrive through different channels and get lost
You need to know which stage each order or service request is at
An internal task is repeated every day and always follows the same rules
includes: Records for clients, products or services
Different access levels for each team member
offerings.practice: We start with the current process: who takes part, what information moves around and where the difficulties are. From there we define the priority features for a first version. New features can be planned later, in agreed stages.
offerings.nextStep: Tell me how the process works today and what gets in the way the most.

offerings.title: Automations and integrations
offerings.need: I want to connect tools I already use and cut down repetitive tasks.
offerings.what: Connections between the tools you already use, so that information moves on its own to where it needs to go. The idea is to reduce repetitive tasks, such as copying data from one place to another or notifying someone by hand.
when: You copy the same information between systems, spreadsheets or emails
Incoming orders have to be passed on to another person or tool
Notices and confirmations are sent one by one
The company's tools don't talk to each other
includes: Sending form data to spreadsheets or other systems
Integration with services that offer an API
Scheduled routines, such as generating a periodic report
offerings.practice: We map the routine step by step and find where information is copied or passed on by hand. Then I check what each tool allows, build the automation and we test it with everyday situations before putting it to use.
offerings.nextStep: Tell me which tools you use and which task you'd like to automate.

process.heading: How it works
process.subheading: From first contact to launch, in six steps.
process.intro: Each step has a clear purpose. You take part in the important decisions and know what comes next.

steps.title: Understand the need
steps.description: We talk about your business, your audience and the problem the project needs to solve.

steps.title: Define the project
steps.description: We define features, priorities and scope. Based on that, I present the price and the timeline.

steps.title: Plan the screens
steps.description: I plan the look and the navigation for desktop, tablet and phone before development starts.

steps.title: Build and test
steps.description: I build the pages and features and test how they work on different screen sizes.

steps.title: Review and launch
steps.description: You review the result, we make the agreed adjustments and I get everything ready to go live.

steps.title: Plan the next steps
steps.description: You get guidance on how to use it. Maintenance and improvements follow whatever we agree on.

process.selectHint: Tap a step to see the details.
